title: HB409 (2025 Regular): AN ACT relating to waiting periods for sales of firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Kentucky); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Kentucky text (Introduced, 0000-00-00; official copy, https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/recorddocuments/bill/25RS/hb409/orig_bill.pdf (LegiScan doc 3108906))
provenance.note: Introduced text (25 RS BR 1051); no passage vote on record.

operative_text:
Section 1 (new section of KRS Chapter 237): A mandatory waiting period of five (5) business days shall be required between the sale of a firearm and the transfer of the firearm to the buyer.
Section 1 (new section of KRS Chapter 237): Records of firearm sales shall be made available at all reasonable hours for inspection by any peace officer acting within the scope of his or her duties.
Section 1 (new section of KRS Chapter 237): This section does not apply to a firearm transfer that does not require a background check under 18 U.S.C. sec. 922(t).
Section 2 (KRS 237.990): Any person who violates Section 1 of this Act shall be guilty of a Class A misdemeanor.
